name: Review RED: fresh settings search
error: Error: Existing window settings route is missing from fresh search
source: async()=>{await noetomeTab.playwright.getByRole('button',{name:'搜索导航',exact:true}).click();await noetomeTab.playwright.getByRole('searchbox',{name:'搜索导航页面'}).fill('窗口设置');await noetomeTab.getAXState(); const matches=await noetomeTab.playwright.getByRole('button',{name:'窗口设置',exact:true}).count(); browserAssert(matches>0,'Existing window settings route is missing from fresh search'); return {matches};}

name: Review RED: overlay dismissal on settings navigation
error: Error: Sidebar overlay remains over focused settings controls
source: async()=>{await noetomeTab.playwright.getByRole('button',{name:'设置',exact:true}).click();await noetomeTab.getAXState();const result=await noetomeTab.playwright.evaluate(()=>({sidebarHidden:document.getElementById('app-sidebar').hidden,focused:document.activeElement.id,heading:document.querySelector('.settings-page-heading').getBoundingClientRect().toJSON()}));browserAssert(result.sidebarHidden,'Sidebar overlay remains over focused settings controls');return result;}
